# vaultwarden_organization_user (List Resource)

Lists the members of an organization, sorted by email, including invited and revoked ones.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the members of an organization, and generate import blocks with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
list "vaultwarden_organization_user" "all" {
  provider = vaultwarden

  config {
    organization_id = "<org_id>"
  }
}

# Only members whose email contains "@example.com", ignoring case
list "vaultwarden_organization_user" "example_com" {
  provider = vaultwarden

  config {
    organization_id = "<org_id>"
    email_contains  = "@example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization to list the members of

### Optional

- `email_contains` (String) Only list the members whose email contains this text, ignoring case
